text: What does CSS stand for in web development?
explanation: Cascading Style Sheets or CSS allows you to specify styles for the visual elements of the website.

text: In the CSS syntax `H1 { color : green }`, what is `H1` called?
explanation: The selector is the HTML element on which you want to apply the style. In the example `H1 { color : green }`, H1 is the selector.

text: Which menu in KompoZer contains the 'Preferences' option to enable CSS?
explanation: To make sure that KompoZer uses CSS by default, click Edit -> Preferences.

text: What is the primary advantage of using CSS?
choices: It is required for saving files.
explanation: Thus we can say that, HTML is used to describe the information content... and not the style, while CSS describes the style... It separates design from implementation.

text: In the CSS syntax, which symbol separates the Property from the Value?
explanation: Declaration consists of a property associated with the HTML element used in selector and its corresponding value. The general syntax is `property : value` (separated by a colon).

text: Which button in the KompoZer Composition toolbar is used to open the CSS Stylesheets dialog box?
explanation: In the composition toolbar, select the Cascade button. This will open the CSS Stylesheets dialog box.

text: Which tab in the CSS Stylesheets dialog allows you to change the Font Family and Font Size?
explanation: The Text tab is shown in figure 2.5... In the Font family section... Font size....

text: To apply a style to all `<h1>` elements on a page, which option should be selected in the 'New Style Rule' section?
choices: style applied to all elements of class
style applied to an element with specified ID
style applied to all elements of type
explanation: Click on the first radio button 'style applied to all elements of type' (selector: h1).

text: Which tab would you use to set a background image for an element?
explanation: To set the background color, select the Background tab... Note: If you want to keep an image in the background then in the Image option, click on 'Choose file'.

text: In the 'Text' tab of the CSS dialog, which option allows you to transform text to 'Uppercase'?
explanation: Choose 'Uppercase' from the Case menu.

text: If you want to set a 'Dotted Border' for an element, which tab in the CSS dialog should you choose?
explanation: The tabs listed in the dialog box include 'Borders'. The requirements list mentions 'Border : Dotted Border', implying this is configured in the Borders tab.

text: What happens if the checkbox 'Use CSS styles instead of HTML elements and attributes' is NOT selected in Preferences?
choices: KompoZer will not save the file.
KompoZer will use HTML tags for formatting instead of CSS.
explanation: Select the checkbox 'Use CSS styles...' if it is not selected. KompoZer will now use the CSS styling instead of HTML to format the text.

text: In the Block Background Color dialog box, color values are represented in which format?
explanation: The dialog box shows a field 'Hex:' with values like #FFFFFF.

text: The CSS syntax consists of special symbols known as:
explanation: The syntax of CSS consists of special symbols known as rules.

text: In the CSS rule `H1 { color : green }`, what is `green`?
explanation: Declaration consists of a property ... and its corresponding value. Here `green` is the Value.

text: Which key can be pressed to execute the 'Cascade' action (implied by typical shortcuts, though button is primary)?
explanation: While the text highlights the 'Cascade button', standard KompoZer usage (and typical exams on this text) often associate F7 with the CSS editor. *Strict text adherence*: The text says 'select the Cascade button'.

text: Under the 'Background' tab, what does the 'Opacity' setting control?
choices: The size of the background image
explanation: The 'Opacity' slider is visible in the Background tab, which generally controls transparency/opaqueness.

text: When creating a new style rule, what appears in the left pane of the CSS Stylesheets window?
choices: The list of sheets and rules (e.g., internal stylesheet)
explanation: Figure 2.4 shows 'Sheets and rules' in the left pane, with 'internal stylesheet' and specific rules like 'h1' listed under it.

text: What does the 'Alignment' option in the 'Text' tab allow you to do?
choices: Set text to Left, Center, or Right
explanation: The Alignment menu in the Text tab (shown in Figure 2.5) is set to 'Center', indicating it controls text alignment.

text: Which HTML tag is used to define a CSS style rule within the document header (internal CSS)?
explanation: Though the text focuses on the GUI, internal stylesheets are technically implemented using the `<style>` tag in the header. The GUI shows 'internal stylesheet'.

text: In the example provided, what font family was selected for the `h1` rule?
explanation: Select the 'predefined' radio button and choose 'Times New Roman' from the drop down menu.

text: Can you specify a background image using the CSS Stylesheets dialog?
choices: Yes, using the 'Image' option in the Background tab.
Yes, but only via the Source tab.
explanation: Note : If you want to keep an image in the background then in the Image option, click on 'Choose file'.

text: What is the default background color if none is selected?
explanation: The 'Transparent' checkbox is visible in the Color dialog, and default backgrounds are typically transparent or white unless specified.

text: Review: In Java, which method is the entry point of a class execution?
explanation: When the class was executed, the main method was called, and the application ran.

text: Review: Which visibility modifier provides the widest access in Java?
explanation: Public provides the widest visibility. Any method or variable is visible to the class... and to all classes outside.

text: Review: Which input type in an HTML form is used for a single-line text box?
explanation: The tag `<input>` ... creates a text field to enter text in the form.

text: Review: In KompoZer, the 'Source' tab is used to:
explanation: The Source tab shows all details of the HTML code. It helps in editing the source code.

text: Review: What does the 'tar' command stand for in Linux?
explanation: On Linux systems, tar (tape archiver) is the most common archive format.

text: Review: Which R function is used to create a bar chart?
explanation: We may use the function `barplot` with various arguments for drawing the plot.

text: Review: In an HTML form, what does the `action` attribute specify?
choices: The file to which form data is submitted
explanation: The action attribute is used to specify where to send the form data... It takes a filename as value.
